target_customer: Indonesian foodservice buyers of poultry: catering SMEs, restaurant and hotel chains, industrial buyers, e-grocery startups and government kitchens
problem: The middle and downstream poultry supply chain in Indonesia is fragmented, so buyers deal with many vendors and get inconsistent quality, pricing and fulfillment.
business_model: Asset light poultry processing and distribution with margin on resale, plus value added services such as marination and repackaging
product_category: B2B food supply chain, halal poultry distribution

founders.name: Chandni Chainani
founders.background_notes: YC page cites 10+ years across e-commerce, F&B and supply chain, focused on growth and monetization. No employers or education listed.

founders.name: Nitish Chellaram
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page. DailySocial quotes him as Nitesh Chellaram, a spelling variant.

competitors.name: Astro
competitors.what: Indonesian quick commerce grocery delivery from dark stores, the closest rival to Dropezy, the company's original business
competitors.traction_then: More than 40 dark stores in Jabodetabek as described by DailySocial

technical_complexity.rationale: Operations heavy supply chain business: procurement, processing and cold chain logistics matter more than software, and the AI layer for pricing and planning is standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Poultry distribution has many players and low switching costs. Halal and NKF certifications and processing assets help only modestly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: As Dropezy, the quick commerce business reportedly closed its dark stores in 2023 and moved to an asset light poultry model; no acquirer is reported.

market_need_then: Fragmented Indonesian foodservice supply with inconsistent quality and pricing, per the company description. Quick commerce funding dried up in 2023, which pushed the pivot.

branding.name_origin: Reported by one search summary that in Indonesian sekilo means a kilo, a nod to the trade. Not confirmed by the company in sources I opened.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain B2B tone: calls itself a dynamic startup and a go to partner for foodservice

rebrands.why: Pivot from quick commerce to poultry processing and distribution (DealStreetAsia, January 2024; TechNode, December 2023)

brand_strength.rationale: A new B2B name with no found press on the brand itself. The name fits the product but there is no evidence it drove growth.

pivots.from: Dropezy, quick commerce grocery delivery from dark stores in Jakarta
pivots.to: Sekilo, AI assisted halal poultry processing and distribution for foodservice
pivots.why: Quick commerce economics worsened and dark stores were reportedly closed; asset light model chosen

outcome_analysis: The company started in 2019 as Dropezy, raised about 2.5 million dollars in 2021 for dark store quick commerce, then joined YC in Winter 2022. By 2023 quick commerce funding had tightened and its dark stores were reportedly closed, so it pivoted to poultry distribution and rebranded as Sekilo in December 2023. It is still active with about 15 people, and the pivot outcome is not yet proven.
notes: Funding: YC page news and DailySocial both state about 2.5M in 2021 (DailySocial calls it a Series A, YC page calls it pre-Series A, so stage is other). Forge Ventures as lead comes from a search summary of aggregator data. Unverified single aggregator figures: SeedTable 3.4M seed in 2022-02, pre-seed 2021-03 from Taurus Ventures and Kopi Kenangan Fund; CB Insights totals range from 150K to 3M. Astro is cited from a 2023 article about Dropezy, so it is the best available evidence of its rival at the time but is dated after the batch. Poultry pivot funding not found.
